description: This file defines configuration and hotkey handling for Plotly charts in a React application, including functions to toggle the modebar, configure plot options, and handle keyboard shortcuts for chart interactions.

methods.name: hideModebar
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the Plotly modebar by manipulating DOM styles.

methods.name: PlotConfig
methods.description: Returns a configuration object for Plotly charts, including mode bar buttons and editing options.

methods.name: ChartHotkeys
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for chart interactions such as opening dialogs, toggling modebar, and changing axis scales.
